risk_name: Climate Stress Cascade Across Legacy Assets
description: Heat flood drought and maintenance backlog interact across aging infrastructure systems.
Cyber physical failure disables material systems through opaque digital dependencies.
Asset-class logic underinvests in low-return needs and shifts costs to users.
Ports cables critical minerals energy corridors and standards become strategic pressure points.
Fragmented institutions turn manageable physical risks into systemic failure.
Distributed systems fail if standards governance and funding are weak.
Good strategy fails if budgets authority procurement and monitoring are misaligned.
Repair gains erode when political cycles cut lifecycle maintenance funding.
